name: Torvi
title: Of the Wolfwinter
examine: The bench by the yard fire is hers. She was eleven when the water went hard, and she is the last one left who was outside that night.
lines: Fourteen names on that stone. There should be fifteen. Ask me when you have sat a while.
You will hear it called a hard winter. It was not a hard winter. It was a hard water.
They ask me if I am afraid of the far shore. I am eighty-one. I am afraid of the stair.
